shared_elements: repeated short linear strokes or bands
justification: Both surfaces include schematic human-like imagery and simple signs such as circles/ovals and repeated linear marks, but these are generic correspondences rather than a shared distinctive motif. A is dominated by a single frontal anthropomorphic body with facial/body features and bands, while B is a dispersed scene of small stick figures and long curved boat- or animal-like forms with repeated strokes, so the relationships and overall iconographic scheme differ strongly.
